name: serverCoveragePercentage
definition: Percentage of the servers in the vendor's endpoint inventory whose protection agent counts as protected under the same transform's requiredCoveragePercentage rule.
population: servers among the endpoints requiredCoveragePercentage divides by. Class rule per vendor: CrowdStrike product_type_desc Server or Domain Controller (product_type 3 or 2 when the description is absent); SentinelOne machineType server; Defender osPlatform containing 'server' or any Linux distribution (ruling 2026-10-16). The denominator and the protected test are exactly the ones the same transform uses for requiredCoveragePercentage, so the split agrees with the blended figure.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the device inventory; 100 only when every server in it is protected. No server in the inventory is null (not measured), never 0.

changeLog.change: Registered with the server / workstation coverage split added to four EDR coverage transforms (additive; no requirement reads it yet).

notes: Added for the EP-001 server / workstation split; the rule that would read it is a later Token-Service change behind a flag. Linux counted as a server and macOS as a workstation per J.J.'s 2026-10-16 ruling.

conflict.summary: The legacy Defender servercoveragepercentage.py emits this key as a string ("0" on error or no servers, str(coverage) otherwise) while the one-click Defender transforms and the four EDR coverage transforms emit a number or null. A string defeats ordered comparators, so the two cannot share one requirement bar.

positions.meaning: Percentage of eligible servers protected, as a number; null when there is no server or the read is not complete.
positions.source: the transforms listed in files, read 2026-10-16

positions.meaning: Percentage of servers onboarded, as a string; "0" on an error or when there is no server.
positions.source: the transform listed in files, read 2026-10-16

proposedResolution.summary: Keep serverCoveragePercentage a number in percent, null when not measured or when there is no server; change the legacy string emitter to match in a separate change. This is a proposal.

decision.question: Should the legacy Defender servercoveragepercentage.py move to a number (null for no server), so this key can become active with valueType number?
